description: The mise this repository installs, on both legs. mise.toml pins the linters and mise.lock pins their artifacts; this file pins the tool that reads them.

sha256 is the mise binary on disk, not the archive it arrived in. jdx/mise-action picks a zip, a tar.gz or a tar.zst depending on the runner, and all three carry the same binary, so one hash per platform covers every path.
jdx/mise-action verifies the archive against the release's minisign-signed SHASUMS256.txt. The hash here is the second, independent check, and it is the one this repository controls.
Renovate moves version and cannot compute these hashes. Its pull request carries a note saying so, and continuous integration stays red until they move with it.
